goal: Dialogue datasets available via ParlAI, usable as training/eval sources.

datasets.name: AmazonQA
datasets.description: This dataset contains Question and Answer data from Amazon, totaling around 1.4 million answered questions.

datasets.name: AQuA
datasets.description: Dataset containing algebraic word problems with rationales for their answers.

datasets.name: bAbI 1k
datasets.description: 20 synthetic tasks that each test a unique aspect of text and reasoning, and hence test different capabilities of learning models.

datasets.name: bAbI 10k
datasets.description: 20 synthetic tasks that each test a unique aspect of text and reasoning, and hence test different capabilities of learning models.

datasets.name: Blended Skill Talk
datasets.description: A dataset of 7k conversations explicitly designed to exhibit multiple conversation modes: displaying personality, having empathy, and demonstrating knowledge.

datasets.name: BookTest
datasets.description: Sentence completion given a few sentences as context from a book. A larger version of CBT.

datasets.name: Bot Adversarial Dialogue
datasets.description: Datasets described in the paper Recipes for Safety in Open-domain Chatbots. Datasets consist of classification tasks in which the goal is to determine if the utterance is offensive or not given a dialogue context.

datasets.name: Safety Mix
datasets.description: Datasets described in the paper: Learning from data in the mixed adversarial non-adversarial case:Finding the helpers and ignoring the trolls. Datasets based on Bot Adversarial Dialogue and consist of a mixture of different troll users.Artificial noise is introduced to the dataset given the troll user type.

datasets.name: Children's Book Test (CBT)
datasets.description: Sentence completion given a few sentences as context from a children's book.

datasets.name: Coached Conversational Preference Elicitation
datasets.description: A dataset consisting of 502 dialogs with 12,000 annotated utterances between a user and an assistant discussing movie preferences in natural language. It was collected using a Wizard-of-Oz methodology between two paid crowd-workers, where one worker plays the role of an 'assistant', while the other plays the role of a 'user'.

datasets.name: CMU Document Grounded Conversations
datasets.description: A document grounded dataset for text conversations, where the documents are Wikipedia articles about popular movies. Consists of 4112 conversations with an average of 21.43 turns per conversation.

datasets.name: Choice of Plausible Alternatives
datasets.description: The Choice Of Plausible Alternatives (COPA) evaluation provides researchers with a tool for assessing progress in open-domain commonsense causal reasoning. COPA consists of 1000 questions, split equally into development and test sets of 500 questions each.

datasets.name: Conversational Question Answering Challenge
datasets.description: CoQA is a large-scale dataset for building Conversational Question Answering systems. The goal of the CoQA challenge is to measure the ability of machines to understand a text passage and answer a series of interconnected questions that appear in a conversation. CoQA is pronounced as coca.

datasets.name: Cornell Movie
datasets.description: Fictional conversations extracted from raw movie scripts.

datasets.name: Dialog Based Language Learning: bAbI Task
datasets.description: Short dialogs based on the bAbI tasks, but in the form of a question from a teacher, the answer from the student, and finally a comment on the answer from the teacher. The aim is to find learning models that use the comments to improve.

datasets.name: Dialog Based Language Learning: WikiMovies Task
datasets.description: Short dialogs based on WikiMovies, but in the form of a question from a teacher, the answer from the student, and finally a comment on the answer from the teacher. The aim is to find learning models that use the comments to improve.

datasets.name: Dialog bAbI
datasets.description: Simulated dialogs of restaurant booking

datasets.name: Dialog bAbI+
datasets.description: bAbI+ is an extension of the bAbI Task 1 dialogues with everyday incremental dialogue phenomena (hesitations, restarts, and corrections) which model the disfluencies and communication problems in everyday spoken interaction in real-world environments.

datasets.name: Dialogue NLI
datasets.description: Dialogue NLI is a dataset that addresses the issue of consistency in dialogue models.

datasets.name: DSTC7 subtrack 1 - ubuntu
datasets.description: DSTC7 is a competition which provided a dataset of dialogs very similar to the ubuntu dataset. In particular, the subtrack 1 consists in predicting the next utterance.

datasets.name: FVQA
datasets.description: The FVQA, a VQA dataset which requires, and supports, much deeper reasoning. We extend a conventional visual question answering dataset, which contains image-question-answer triplets, through additional image-question-answer-supporting fact tuples. The supporting fact is represented as a structural triplet, such as <Cat,CapableOf,ClimbingTrees>.

datasets.name: Deal or No Deal
datasets.description: End-to-end negotiation task which requires two agents to agree on how to divide a set of items, with each agent assigning different values to each item.

datasets.name: Friends
datasets.description: Multi-party conversation dataset modified from the 10 seasons of the popular American sitcom that ran in the 90s, Friends.

datasets.name: Glue
datasets.description: GLUE, the General Language Understanding Evaluation benchmark is a collection of resources for training, evaluating, and analyzing natural language understanding systems.

datasets.name: HotpotQA
datasets.description: HotpotQA is a dataset for multi-hop question answering. The overall setting is that given some context paragraphs(e.g., a few paragraphs, or the entire Web) and a question,a QA system answers the question by extracting a span of textfrom the context. It is necessary to perform multi-hop reasoningto correctly answer the question.

datasets.name: HuggingFace
datasets.description: HuggingFace datasets

datasets.name: LIGHT-Dialogue
datasets.description: LIGHT is a text adventure game with actions and dialogue collected. The source data is collected between crowdworkers playing the game.

datasets.name: LIGHT-Dialogue-Wild
datasets.description: LIGHT is a text adventure game with actions and dialogue. The WILD dataset here features 41,131+ training episodes of dialogue collected from deploying a game as described in

datasets.name: MutualFriends
datasets.description: Task where two agents must discover which friend of theirs is mutual based on the friends's attributes.

datasets.name: MCTest
datasets.description: Questions about short children's stories.

datasets.name: Movie Dialog QA
datasets.description: Closed-domain QA dataset asking templated questions about movies, answerable from Wikipedia, similar to WikiMovies.

datasets.name: Movie Dialog QA Recommendations
datasets.description: Dialogs discussing questions about movies as well as recommendations.

datasets.name: Movie Dialog Recommendations
datasets.description: Questions asking for movie recommendations.

datasets.name: Movie Dialog Reddit
datasets.description: Dialogs discussing Movies from Reddit (the Movies SubReddit).

datasets.name: MTurk WikiMovies
datasets.description: Closed-domain QA dataset asking MTurk-derived questions about movies, answerable from Wikipedia.

datasets.name: MultiNLI
datasets.description: A dataset designed for use in the development and evaluation of machine learning models for sentence understanding. Each example contains a premise and hypothesis. Model has to predict whether premise and hypothesis entail, contradict or are neutral to each other.

datasets.name: NarrativeQA
datasets.description: A dataset and set of tasks in which the reader must answer questions about stories by reading entire books or movie scripts.

datasets.name: Natural Questions
datasets.description: An open domain question answering dataset. Each example contains real questions that people searched for in Google and the content of the a Wikipedia article that was amongst the top 5 search results for that query, and its annotations. The annotations have the options of a long answer that is seleced from span of major content entities in the Wikipedia article (e.g., paragraphs, tables), a short answer that is selected from one or more short span of words in the article, or 'yes/no'. The existence of any of these answer formats depends on whether the main question can be answered, given the article; if not they are left empty.

datasets.name: Open Subtitles
datasets.description: Dataset of dialogs from movie scripts.

datasets.name: Personalized Dialog Full Set
datasets.description: Simulated dataset of restaurant booking focused on personalization based on user profiles.

datasets.name: Personalized Dialog Small Set
datasets.description: Simulated dataset of restaurant booking focused on personalization based on user profiles.

datasets.name: Prosocial Dialog
datasets.description: Prosocial Dialog dataset of 58K dialogues between a speaker showing potentially unsafe behavior and a speaker giving constructive feedback for more socially acceptable behavior.

datasets.name: QA CNN
datasets.description: Cloze dataset based on a missing (anonymized) entity phrase from a CNN article

datasets.name: QA Daily Mail
datasets.description: Cloze dataset based on a missing (anonymized) entity phrase from a Daily Mail article.

datasets.name: Question Answering in Context
datasets.description: Question Answering in Context is a dataset for modeling, understanding, and participating in information seeking dialog. Data instances consist of an interactive dialog between two crowd workers: (1) a student who poses a sequence of freeform questions to learn as much as possible about a hidden Wikipedia text, and (2) a teacher who answers the questions by providing short excerpts (spans) from the text. QuAC introduces challenges not found in existing machine comprehension datasets: its questions are often more open-ended, unanswerable, or only meaningful within the dialog context.

datasets.name: Simple Questions
datasets.description: Open-domain QA dataset based on Freebase triples.

datasets.name: Reframe Unhelpful Thoughts
datasets.description: Dataset of about 10k examples of thoughts containing unhelpful thought patterns conditioned on a given persona, accompanied by about 27k positive reframes.

datasets.name: The Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) Corpus
datasets.description: The SNLI corpus (version 1.0) is a collection of 570k human-written English sentence pairs manually labeled for balanced classification with the labels entailment, contradiction, and neutral, supporting the task of natural language inference (NLI), also known as recognizing textual entailment (RTE)

datasets.name: SQuAD2
datasets.description: Open-domain QA dataset answerable from a given paragraph from Wikipedia.

datasets.name: SQuAD
datasets.description: Open-domain QA dataset answerable from a given paragraph from Wikipedia.

datasets.name: SuperGLUE
datasets.description: SuperGLUE (https://super.gluebenchmark.com/) is a new benchmark styled after GLUE with a new set of more difficult language understanding tasks, improved resources, and a new public leaderboard.

datasets.name: TriviaQA
datasets.description: Open-domain QA dataset with question-answer-evidence triples.

datasets.name: Task N' Talk
datasets.description: Dataset of synthetic shapes described by attributes, for agents to play a cooperative QA game.

datasets.name: Ubuntu
datasets.description: Dialogs between an Ubuntu user and an expert trying to fix issue, we use the V2 version, which cleaned the data to some extent.

datasets.name: Web Questions
datasets.description: Open-domain QA dataset from Web queries.

datasets.name: WikiMovies
datasets.description: Closed-domain QA dataset asking templated questions about movies, answerable from Wikipedia.

datasets.name: WikiQA
datasets.description: Open domain QA from Wikipedia dataset

datasets.name: VQAv1
datasets.description: Open-ended question answering about visual content.

datasets.name: VQAv2
datasets.description: Bigger, more balanced version of the original VQA dataset.

datasets.name: VisDial
datasets.description: Task which requires agents to hold a meaningful dialog about visual content.

datasets.name: MNIST_QA
datasets.description: Task which requires agents to identify which number they are seeing. From the MNIST dataset.

datasets.name: InsuranceQA
datasets.description: Task which requires agents to identify high quality answers composed by professionals with deep domain knowledge.

datasets.name: MS_MARCO
datasets.description: A large scale Machine Reading Comprehension Dataset with questions sampled from real anonymized user queries and contexts from web documents.

datasets.name: CLEVR
datasets.description: A visual reasoning dataset that tests abilities such as attribute identification, counting, comparison, spatial relationships, and logical operations.

datasets.name: nlvr
datasets.description: Cornell Natural Language Visual Reasoning (NLVR) is a language grounding dataset based on pairs of natural language statements grounded in synthetic images.

datasets.name: WMT
datasets.description: Workshop on Machine Translation task, currently only includes en_de.

datasets.name: IWSLT14
datasets.description: 2014 International Workshop on Spoken Language task, currently only includes en_de and de_en.

datasets.name: ConvAI2
datasets.description: A chit-chat dataset based on PersonaChat for a NIPS 2018 competition.

datasets.name: ConvAI_ChitChat
datasets.description: Human-bot dialogues containing free discussions of randomly chosen paragraphs from SQuAD.

datasets.name: Dialogue_QE
datasets.description: Human-bot dialogues labelled for quality at the level of dialogues. Can be used to train dialogue-level metric for dialogue systems.

datasets.name: QAngaroo
datasets.description: Reading Comprehension with Multiple Hop. Including two datasets: WIKIHOP built on on wikipedia, MEDHOP built on paper abstracts from PubMed.

datasets.name: SCAN
datasets.description: SCAN is a set of simple language-driven navigation tasks for studying compositional learning and zero-shot generalization. The SCAN tasks were inspired by the CommAI environment, which is the origin of the acronym (Simplified versions of the CommAI Navigation tasks).

datasets.name: Persona-Chat
datasets.description: A chit-chat dataset where paired Turkers are given assigned personas and chat to try to get to know each other.

datasets.name: TaskMaster-1-2019
datasets.description: A chit-chat dataset by GoogleAI providing high quality goal-oriented conversationsThe dataset hopes to provoke interest in written vs spoken languageBoth the datasets consists of two-person dialogs:Spoken: Created using Wizard of Oz methodology. Written: Created by crowdsourced workers who were asked to write the full conversation themselves playing roles of both the user and assistant.

datasets.name: MSR End-to-End
datasets.description: MSR-E2E is a dataset of human-human conversations in which one human plays the role of an Agent and the other one plays the roleof a User. Data is collected from Amazon Mechanical Turk.

datasets.name: Twitter
datasets.description: Twitter data found on GitHub. No train/valid/test split was provided so 10k for valid and 10k for test was chosen at random.

datasets.name: Wikipedia
datasets.description: Dump of Wikipedia articles from 2/3/18

datasets.name: Flickr30k
datasets.description: 30k captioned images pulled from Flickr compiled by UIUC.

datasets.name: COCO_Captions
datasets.description: COCO annotations derived from the 2015 COCO Caption Competition.

datasets.name: Integration Tests
datasets.description: Artificial tasks for ensuring models perform as expected

datasets.name: ConvAI2_wild_evaluation
datasets.description: Dataset collected during the wild evaluation of ConvaAI2 participants bots. 60% train, 20% valid and 20% test is chosen at random from the whole dataset.

datasets.name: SST Sentiment Analysis
datasets.description: Dataset containing sentiment trees of movie reviews. We use the modified binary sentence analysis subtask given by the DecaNLP paper here.

datasets.name: CNN/DM Summarisation
datasets.description: Dataset collected from CNN and the Daily Mail with summaries as labels, Implemented as part of the DecaNLP task.

datasets.name: QA-SRL Semantic Role Labeling
datasets.description: QA dataset implemented as part of the DecaNLP task.

datasets.name: QA-ZRE Relation Extraction
datasets.description: Zero Shot relation extraction task implemented as part of the DecaNLP task.

datasets.name: WOZ restuarant reservation (Goal-Oriented Dialogue)
datasets.description: Dataset containing dialogues dengotiating a resturant reservation. Implemented as part of the DecaNLP task, focused on the change in the dialogue state.

datasets.name: WikiSQL semantic parsing task
datasets.description: Dataset for parsing sentences to SQL code, given a table. Implemented as part of the DecaNLP task.

datasets.name: MWSC pronoun resolution
datasets.description: Resolving possible ambiguous pronouns. Implemented as part of the DecaNLP task, and can be found on the decaNLP github.

datasets.name: DecaNLP: The Natural Language Decathlon
datasets.description: A collection of 10 tasks (SQuAD, IWSLT, CNN/DM, MNLI, SST, QA‑SRL,QA‑ZRE, WOZ, WikiSQL and MWSC) designed to challenge a model with a range of different tasks. Note that we use IWSLT 2014 instead of 2016/2013test/2014test for train/dev/test as given in the DecaNLP paper.

datasets.name: Personality_Captions
datasets.description: 200k images from the YFCC100m dataset with captions conditioned on one of 215 personalities.

datasets.name: Image_Chat
datasets.description: 202k dialogues and 401k utterances over 202k images from the YFCC100m dataset using 215 possible personality traits

datasets.name: Image_Chat_Generation
datasets.description: Image Chat task to train generative model

datasets.name: Wizard_of_Wikipedia
datasets.description: A dataset with conversations directly grounded with knowledge retrieved from Wikipedia. Contains 201k utterances from 22k dialogues spanning over 1300 diverse topics, split into train, test, and valid sets. The test and valid sets are split into two sets each: one with overlapping topics with the train set, and one with unseen topics.

datasets.name: Wizard_of_Wikipedia_Generator
datasets.description: Wizard of Wikipedia task to train generative models

datasets.name: Daily Dialog
datasets.description: A dataset of chitchat dialogues with strong annotations for topic, emotion and utterance act. This version contains both sides of every conversation, and uses the official train/valid/test splits from the original authors.

datasets.name: Empathetic Dialogues
datasets.description: A dataset of 25k conversations grounded in emotional situations to facilitate training and evaluating dialogue systems. Dataset has been released under the CC BY-NC license.

datasets.name: Dialogue Safety
datasets.description: Several datasets described in the paper Built it Break it Fix it for Dialogue Safety: Robustness from Adversarial Human Attack. All datasets are classification tasks in which the goal is to determine if the text is offensive or 'safe'.

datasets.name: MultiDoGo
datasets.description: MultiDoGo is a large task-oriented dataset from Amazon collected in a Wizard of Oz fashion, using both crowd and expert annotators with annotations at varying levels of granularity.

datasets.name: MultiWOZ 2.0
datasets.description: A fully labeled collection of human-written conversations spanningover multiple domains and topics.

datasets.name: MultiWOZ 2.1
datasets.description: A fully labeled collection of human-written conversations spanningover multiple domains and topics.

datasets.name: MultiWOZ 2.2
datasets.description: A fully labeled collection of human-written conversations spanningover multiple domains and topics. Schemas are included.

datasets.name: SelfChat
datasets.description: Not a dataset, but a generic world for model self-chats.

datasets.name: OneCommon
datasets.description: A collaborative referring task which requires advanced skills of common grounding under continuous and partially-observable context. This code also includes reference-resolution annotation.

datasets.name: Image Grounded Conversations
datasets.description: A dataset of (image, context, question, answer) tuples, comprised of eventful images taken from Bing, Flickr, and COCO.

datasets.name: Adversarial Natural Language Inference (ANLI) Corpus
datasets.description: The ANLI corpus (version 1.0) is a new large-scale NLI benchmark dataset,collected via an iterative, adversarial human-and-model-in-the-loop procedurewith the labels entailment, contradiction, and neutral. A total of three rounds of data are collected that progressively increase in difficulty and complexity.

datasets.name: Natural Language Inference (NLI) Corpus
datasets.description: A collection of 3 popular Natural Language Inference(NLI) benchmark tasks: ANLI v0.1, MultiNLI 1.0, SNLI 1.0.

datasets.name: Funpedia
datasets.description: Task for rephrasing sentences from Wikipedia conditioned on a persona.

datasets.name: LIGHT Gender Bias
datasets.description: Task for debiasing the LIGHT dataset.

datasets.name: AirDialogue
datasets.description: Task for goal-oriented dialogue using airplane booking conversations between agents and customers.

datasets.name: Holl-E
datasets.description: Sequence of utterances and responses with background knowledge aboutmovies. From the Holl-E dataset.

datasets.name: ELI5
datasets.description: This dataset contains Question and Answer data from Reddit explainlikeimfive posts and comments.

datasets.name: ReDial
datasets.description: Annotated dataset of dialogues where users recommend movies to each other.

datasets.name: DREAM
datasets.description: A multiple-choice answering dataset based on multi-turn, multi-party dialogue.

datasets.name: C3
datasets.description: A multiple-choice answering dataset in Chinese based on a prior passage.

datasets.name: CommonSenseQA
datasets.description: CommonSenseQA is a multiple-choice Q-A dataset that relies on commonsense knowlegde to predict correct answers.

datasets.name: Style-Controlled Generation
datasets.description: Dialogue datasets (BlendedSkillTalk, ConvAI2, EmpatheticDialogues, and Wizard of Wikipedia) labeled with personalities taken from the Image-Chat dataset. Used for the style-controlled generation project

datasets.name: GoogleSGD
datasets.description: The Schema-Guided Dialogue (SGD) dataset consists of over 20k annotated multi-domain, task-oriented conversations between a human and a virtual assistant.

datasets.name: GoogleSGD Simulation Splits
datasets.description: Custom processing of the Google SGD dataset into In-Domain and Out-of-Domain splits for the use of zero and few-shotting with other task-oriented data.

datasets.name: TaskMaster2
datasets.description: The second version of TaskMaster, containing Wizard-of-Oz dialogues for task oriented dialogue in 7 domains.

datasets.name: TicketTalk (Taskmaster3)
datasets.description: Taskmaster3 is a dataset of movie ticket dialogues collected in a self-chat manner. To induce conversationalvariety, crowd workers were asked to generate conversations given dozens of different instructions ofdifferent level of specificity, some purposefully including conversational errors.

datasets.name: GenderationBiasControlTask
datasets.description: A teacher that wraps other ParlAI tasks and appends control tokens to the text field indicating the presence of gender words in the label(s).

datasets.name: MD Gender
datasets.description: Tasks for the multi-dimensional gender bias classifier training.

datasets.id: Sensitive Topics Evaluation Topics Valid Teacher
datasets.name: Sensitive Topics Evaluation Topics Valid Teacher
datasets.description: Task for evaluating a classifier trained to identify conversational messages on the following sensitive topics: Politics, Drugs, Medical Advice, Religion, Relationships & Dating / NSFW.

datasets.name: DialoguE COntradiction DEteCtion (DECODE)
datasets.description: Task for detect whether the last utterance contradicts previous dialogue history.

datasets.name: MetaLWOz
datasets.description: Meta-Learning Wizard-of-Oz (MetaLWOz) is a dataset designed to help develop models capable of predicting user responses in unseen domains.

datasets.name: Wizard_of_Internet
datasets.description: A dataset with conversations directly grounded with knowledge retrieved from internet. One of the participants has access to internet search. The other side has an assigned persona that provides the topic of the conversation. Contains 93.7k utterances from 9.6k conversations, split into train, test, and valid sets.

datasets.name: MultiSessionChat
datasets.description: A multi-session human-human chit-chat dataset consist of session 2-5 follow up from PersonaChat It contains 5k full converesations from session 2 to session 5 (session 1 being PersonaChat)

datasets.name: JerichoWorld
datasets.description: Jericho World dataset: common sense in a text-based game. The goal is generating the knowledge graph of the game state or the set of valid actions from the text descriptions of the world.

datasets.name: CaSiNo (CampSite Negotiation Dialogues)
datasets.description: A dataset of 1030 negotiation dialogues. Two participants take the role of campsite neighbors and negotiate forFood, Water, and Firewood packages, based on their individual preferences and requirements.

datasets.name: SaFeRDialogues
datasets.description: A dataset of 8k dialogues demonstrating safety failures, feedback signaling them, and a response acknowledging the feedback. Dataset has been released under the CC BY-NC license.

datasets.name: XPersona
datasets.description: XPersona is an extension of ConvAI2 with six more languages: Chinese, French, Indonesian, Italian, Korean, and Japanese.

datasets.name: LCCC
datasets.description: Large-scale cleaned Chinese conversation dataset.

datasets.name: SPOLIN
datasets.description: Conversation pairs from the SPOLIN dataset. The pairs abide by the Yes-and principle ofimprovisational theatre (improv).

datasets.name: FITS
datasets.description: A human-model dialogue dataset consist of 14k dialogues where human speakers give feedbacks on bot responses.

datasets.name: EntailmentBank
datasets.description: 2k multi-step entailment trees, explaining the answers to ARC science questions.

datasets.name: ASDIV
datasets.description: A diverse corpus for evaluating and developing English math Wword problem solvers.

datasets.name: MathDataset
datasets.description: 12,500 challenging competition mathematics problems.

datasets.name: EQASC
datasets.description: Reasoning chains for multihop question-answering set QASC.

datasets.name: Reasoning Framework
datasets.description: Reasoning teacher framework.

datasets.name: ProofWriter
datasets.description: A synthentically dataset of initial clauses and rules, with questions about statements that these initialclauses and rules imply.

datasets.name: Multi-party LIGHT
datasets.description: Multi-party async conversation between 3 role-playing characters.
